pre_registered_acceptance_criteria.wilson_interval_coverage: Pass if target model's published SR lies within the empirical Wilson 95% confidence interval on the 100 episodes
pre_registered_acceptance_criteria.spl_tolerance: Empirical SPL within +/- 0.10 of published backbone SPL
pre_registered_acceptance_criteria.dual_reporting_mandate: Both full 100-episode set and 78-episode unexposed set MUST be reported alongside each other
pre_registered_acceptance_criteria.failure_audit_rule: Audit at least 20 failures across taxonomy; do not tune harness parameters on locked-set failures
